@@ -112,12 +112,16 @@ type State struct {
 	StartTree       string            `json:"start_tree"`

+	Pass    int    `json:"pass"`
+	Review  int    `json:"review"`
+	Repairs int    `json:"repairs"`

 	LastPass         *verify.Pass                   `json:"last_pass"`
 	LastReview       *ReviewRecord                  `json:"last_review"`
